headline: UTI Nifty 500 ETF share price tracking on NSE and BSE
hook: Routine ticker data for UTI Nifty ETF
summary: This article is a routine market data page providing live share price information for the UTI Nifty 500 ETF on the National Stock Exchange and Bombay Stock Exchange.
